title: 第14章 他想临幸我母后
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
路上，陆舟弄清了所救女子的身份。

    对方名叫柳仙儿，本是来茶州城寻亲的，不料撞上袁决，遭到对方觊觎，险些被卖到青楼。

    经此一遭，她久久惊魂未定，说完来历后便一言不发，低头默默跟着。

    陆舟寻思着等解决袁氏父子的事后，便让周川将其妥善送走。

    结果临近梅园，柳仙儿突然拜倒在了他的面前。

    “王爷大恩，仙儿没齿难忘。”

    她声音不大，语速却快，像是在给自己壮胆：“王爷但凡有所需，仙儿纵使粉身碎骨也在所不惜。”

    “举手之劳，不必在意。”陆舟略感意外，摆手道。

    他的目的主要是袁决，救下对方不过顺手而为，并不求任何回报。

    “王爷，仙儿这条命是您救的，若不能报答，此心难宁，此生难安！绝不能就此作罢。”柳仙儿却无比坚持，大有一副长跪不起的架势。

    陆舟沉默了。

    气氛僵了一瞬。

    一旁，周川的目光在二人之间打了个来回，略一思索，笑吟吟开了口：“王爷，去云州路途艰辛，不如让她跟着您，充当侍女吧。”

    此一这话，既给出了建议，又缓解了尴尬

    柳仙儿愣了愣，咬着下唇迟疑了两三息，伏下身去，额头磕在青石上，闷闷一声响：“王爷，仙儿这条命是您救的。为奴为婢，结草衔环，仙儿都心甘情愿，只求终生侍奉您左右。”

    陆舟本想说不用，却被这份情真意切给噎了回去。

    他是个现代人，让一个活生生的人给自己当侍女，怎么想怎么别扭。

    可低头撞上那双满是恳切的眼睛，话到了嘴边又咽了回去。

    他不太会拒绝别人的请求，尤其当这个人看起来孤苦伶仃，无处可去……

    “……那就先跟着吧。”

    柳仙儿重重磕了个头。

    路上，陆舟一直琢磨这事，心里有些说不上来的感觉。

    作为一个现代人，因为救了个女人，对方就要为奴为婢的报答，还真有点不太适应。

    可念头一转，又想起前世自己熬夜加班、饥一顿饱一顿，想起换下的四处乱丢的衣裳，……

    嘴角不经意地微微勾起。

    眼中，也多了几分说不清道不明的期待。

    ……

    刺史府。

    袁成刚刚处理好管家的事，回到了宴席中。

    这时，忽然有下人来报：“老爷，不好了，少爷被云王抓住带走了！”

    歌舞骤停！

    “什么？”袁成大惊失色。

    袁决乃是他老来得子，是唯一的继承人。

    平日里，他对这儿子极为宠爱，捧在手里怕掉了，含在嘴里怕坏了，那是一点责罚都不敢给。

    怎么突然就被云王抓走了？

    那下人连忙将事情来龙去脉一一告知。

    “呵，这位云王殿下还真是睚眦必报啊！”一旁看热闹不嫌事大的刘傲听完后，不由冷笑一声。

    这话，分明是说陆舟在伺机报复。

    砰！

    袁成猛然将手中酒杯砸在地上，老脸扭曲，怒火中烧。

    又是陆舟！
content_en:
On the way, Lu Zhou found out the identity of the woman he rescued.

    The other party's name was Liu Xian'er, who originally came to Chazhou City to find relatives, but unexpectedly bumped into Yuan Jue, who coveted him and was almost sold to a brothel.

    After this encounter, she was in shock for a long time. After telling her origin, she remained silent and followed silently with her head lowered.

    Lu Zhou thought that after solving the problem of Yuan and his son, he would ask Zhou Chuan to send them away properly.

    As he approached the plum garden, Liu Xianer suddenly fell down in front of him.

    "Your Majesty's great kindness, Xian'er will never forget it."

    Her voice was not loud, but she spoke quickly, as if she was emboldening herself: "Whenever the prince needs it, Xian'er will not hesitate even if he is broken into pieces."

    "It's easy, don't worry about it." Lu Zhou was slightly surprised and waved his hand.

    His main goal was Yuan Jue, and he just did it casually without asking for anything in return.

    "Your Majesty, Xian'er's life was saved by you. If you can't repay her, your heart will be uneasy and your life will be uneasy! You can't give up just now." Liu Xian'er was extremely insistent, as if he could not kneel down for a long time.

    Lu Zhou fell silent.

    The atmosphere was tense for a moment.

    On the side, Zhou Chuan's eyes flicked back and forth between the two of them. After thinking for a moment, he smiled and said, "My lord, the journey to Yunzhou is difficult, so why not let her follow you and act as a maid."

    These words not only gave advice but also alleviated the embarrassment.

    Liu Xian'er was stunned for a moment, biting her lower lip and hesitated for two or three breaths. Then she leaned down, knocked her forehead on the bluestone, and said in a muffled voice: "Your Majesty, Xian'er's life was saved by you. Xian'er is willing to be a slave, a maid, and wear a ring of grass. She only wants to serve you for the rest of her life."

    Lu Zhou wanted to say no, but was choked back by the sincerity of this sentiment.

    He is a modern man, and it would be awkward for him to have a living person serve as his maid, no matter how he thinks about it.

    But when he lowered his head and met those eyes full of sincerity, he swallowed the words as they reached his lips.

    He is not very likely to refuse someone else's request, especially if the person seems to be alone and has nowhere to go...

    "...Then just follow."

    Liu Xianer kowtowed heavily.

    On the way, Lu Zhou kept thinking about this matter and had some indescribable feelings in his heart.

    As a modern person, it is a bit uncomfortable for a woman to be repaid by becoming a slave in return for saving her life.

    But as soon as my thoughts changed, I remembered that in my previous life, I stayed up late and worked overtime, and I was hungry and full, and I thought of the clothes I had changed and littered everywhere...

    The corners of his mouth were slightly raised inadvertently.

    There was also a bit of indescribable expectation in his eyes.

    …

    Governor's Mansion.

    Yuan Cheng had just finished handling the housekeeper's affairs and returned to the banquet.

    At this time, a servant suddenly came to report: "Master, it's bad, the young master was caught and taken away by King Yun!"

    The singing and dancing stopped suddenly!

    "What?" Yuan Cheng was shocked.

    Yuan Jue was his son and his only heir.

    On weekdays, he loved his son very much. He would hold it in his hands for fear of dropping it and hold it in his mouth for fear of breaking it. He would not dare to punish him at all.

    Why was he suddenly captured by King Yun?

    The servant quickly told the whole story one by one.

    "Haha, His Royal Highness King Yun really must retaliate for his anger!" Liu Ao, who was watching the excitement and not taking it too seriously, couldn't help but sneered after hearing this.

    This statement clearly meant that Lu Zhou was waiting for an opportunity to retaliate.

    Bang!

    Yuan Cheng suddenly smashed the wine glass in his hand on the ground, his old face twisted and burning with anger.

    It’s Lu Zhou again!
title_en: Chapter 14 He Wants to Visit My Mother
